digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira and adapters/jira_family - shared layer extraction
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general units (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary, status/priority maps) from adapters/jira/ into a new public jira_family/ package to eliminate unsanctioned cross-adapter imports and establish a clean seam between backend-neutral core and adapter-specific implementations.

Move identity.py and probe's classify_probe_response classifier wholesale to jira_family/, while parameterizing classify_probe_response to accept resolved-status set rather than reading Cloud-specific RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, which remains defined in adapters/jira/probe.py as Cloud's configured value.

Split jira_fields.py by symbol: move outright those with no pinned-module dependencies (_sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary, InvalidLabelError, _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, value maps); move contract-parameterized those with pinned dependencies (_sanitize_description receives RichTextCodec; _sanitize_comment receives comment-limit contract), with adapters/jira/jira_fields.py surviving as Cloud-side contract-construction site.

Keep adapters/jira/adf.py, adapters/jira/comment_limits.py, and adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py at their pinned paths, sharing them via dependency inversion (importing jira_family contracts, never the reverse) rather than relocation.

Unify dual local-to-Jira status and priority map copies into single definition in jira_family/, adopting the outbound_fields version which includes deleted→Done (fixing latent ACLI bug where deleted status fell through to invalid Deleted instead of applying a real workflow state).

Update all internal importers and mock.patch strings to absolute imports from jira_family/ rather than old paths, with no re-export shims; verify absolute imports survive spec_from_file_location under synthetic module names with no package context; enforce import contract with persistent AST-walking test in test suite to prevent future sibling-adapter imports.
